name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/pdf-ocr
description: Text for scanned PDFs: each textless page's scan, as the PDF stores it, recognized by a pinned Tesseract, kept as a text file beside the PDF, and given to PDF.js as its text. The Annotator plugin and the site run the same code, so they get the same text.
//license: Not under packages/annotator: the site imports it, and nothing AGPL may reach the site. Its dependencies are Apache-2.0.
//exports: Source only: no build and no dist. Whoever uses it compiles it, and Node strips its types. `.` runs anywhere (a page, a Web Worker, Node); `./node` is Node's way to run it, with worker threads; `./text` is reading a text file only, for a page that shows one.
